name: Tinker Firearms scopes modify Rocket Launcher (#3117, #3118)
contract: #3117 Mega Scope 707252 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER +10 on SPELLMOD_RANGE (DBC EffectBasePoints 9, DieSides 1) with class mask 0x04000000, which selects Rocket Launcher 500235 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 0x04000000, rangeIndex 114 = 35 yd). Its range must become 45 yd. #3118 Buster Scope 707253 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER +10 on SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS; its class mask is 0/0/0x01000000, which selects the triggered damage spell Rocket Launcher 500220 (SpellFamilyFlags[2] 0x01000000), not the launcher 500235 the group report named. Both are stock spell modifiers, so no script is needed. Scrap Shot 500549 is the control: it is SpellFamilyName 34 with rangeIndex 114 too, and neither mask touches it.

steps.label: Rocket Launcher starts at the DBC range of 35 yd
No crit damage modifier applies to Rocket Launcher yet
Mega Scope adds its 10 yd to Rocket Launcher
Mega Scope leaves Scrap Shot's range alone
Buster Scope raises Rocket Launcher's crit bonus by 10%
The native crit calculation carries the bonus
Buster Scope does not touch Scrap Shot's modifier
Buster Scope does not touch Scrap Shot's crit damage
